name: translate_english
description: Translate text to or from English (English)
procedure:
1. Identify the source language and target language.
2. If translating TO English: produce a natural, idiomatic English translation.
3. If translating FROM English: detect target language and translate accurately.
4. Preserve meaning, tone, and cultural nuances.
5. If a phrase has no direct equivalent, provide the closest cultural match with a brief note.
